## Configure environment. Load data.
```{r, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

#-------------------------------
# data frame for
# mortality spatial modeling
#-------------------------------
df_all

df_all$district[df_all$district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)"] <- "Tibiri"
df_all$district[df_all$district=="Illela"] <- "Illéla"
districts <- unique(df_all$district)

b_boxgrid_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:15) {
```

## Spatial predictions of mortality and ATE [spaMM] 
#### Create spaMM models.
```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------------
# fit spatial models for mortality rate with new binary tx vars,
# isTreated_child: 0=placebo+infant, 1=child
# isTreated_alltx: 0=placebo, 1=infant+child

# NOW, we loop through each district and create_fitme
#--------------------------------------------------------------
results_spaMM_districts$district <- districts

fitmort_districts <- list()
fitmort_int_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  fitmort_districts[[i]] <- create_fitme(df = df_all %>% 
                                           dplyr::filter(district==districts[i]) )
  
  fitmort_int_districts[[i]] <- create_fitme_int(df = df_all %>% 
                                                   dplyr::filter(district==districts[i]) )
  
  # summary(fitmort_districts[[i]])
  # summary(fitmort_int_districts[[i]])
  
  # save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))
  
}

# Note: Treatment est. is much larger because the scale of the lat/lon is large. 

results_spaMM_districts$fitmort <- fitmort_districts
results_spaMM_districts$fitmort_int <- fitmort_int_districts


# save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))

```

#### Create model predictions per treatment arm.
```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
# tx0 = Treatment, tx1 = Control
#--------------------------------------

b_preds_mort_tx0_districts <- list()
b_preds_mort_tx1_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  b_preds_mort_tx0_districts[[i]] <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid_districts[[i]],
                                                  spamm_model_fit = fitmort_districts[[i]],
                                                  tx_group=unique(df_all$isTreated_child)[1])
  
  b_preds_mort_tx1_districts[[i]] <- get_grid_preds(input_grid = b_boxgrid_districts[[i]],
                                                  spamm_model_fit = fitmort_districts[[i]],
                                                  tx_group=unique(df_all$isTreated_child)[2])
  
  # save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_tx1_districts

# save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))

```

#### Convert predictions into mapping elements.
```{r convert to raster}
#--------------------------------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean to a raster to make it 
# a regular set of tiles (rather than points), then to tibble 
# for ggplot2.
# scale prevalence by 100 to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------------------------------

# edited this 6/1 -- mask and crop changed to district

b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_districts <- list()
b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_districts <- list()

b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_districts <- list()
b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_districts <- list()

b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_districts <- list()
b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_districts[[i]] <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx0_districts[[i]])
  b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_districts[[i]] <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_tx1_districts[[i]])

  temp_coords_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_districts[[i]]
  temp_coords_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_districts[[i]]
  temp_mort_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_tx0_districts[[i]]
  temp_mort_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_tx1_districts[[i]]
  
  b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_districts[[i]] <- points_to_raster(
    x = temp_coords_tx0[,1],
    y = temp_coords_tx0[,2],
    z = temp_mort_tx0$pred,
    mask1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i]),
    crop1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i])
    )
  
  print("Points to raster done (tx0)")
  
  b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_districts[[i]] <- points_to_raster(
    x = temp_coords_tx1[,1],
    y = temp_coords_tx1[,2],
    z = temp_mort_tx1$pred,
    mask1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i]),
    crop1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i]) )
  
   print("Points to raster done (tx1)")
   
  b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_districts[[i]] <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_districts[[i]])
  # print("Raster to tibble done (tx0)")
  
  b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_districts[[i]] <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_districts[[i]])
  # print("Raster to tibble done (tx1)")
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_coords_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_coords_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_coords_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_districts

results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_raster_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_raster_tx1_districts

results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0 <- b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1 <- b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_districts

# save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))

```


```{r ATE surface}
#--------------------------------------------------------------
# create predicted surface of the ATE by calculating
# the difference of raster values at each coord
#--------------------------------------------------------------

b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  #Note: when tx0 and tx1 raster2 get fixed, switch to value.y - value.x
  b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_districts[[i]] <-
    b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_districts[[i]] %>%
    left_join(b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_districts[[i]], by = join_by(x,y)) %>%
    mutate(value = value.x - value.y) %>%
    rename(variable = variable.y) %>%
    dplyr::select(x,y,value,variable)
  
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff <- b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_districts

min(results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster2_diff[[5]]$value, na.rm=T)

# save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))
```

#### Calculate uncertainty from simulations (`simulate()`).

```{r simulate-prep}
# Simulate new response data based on the fitted model

# Steps:
#   Simulate for placebo + tx arm (foreach::doParallel)
#   Subtract from each other for ATE
#   Use sims_diar() 

relevel(df_all$isTreated_child, ref = "Control")

newd2_districts <- list()
newd3_districts <- list()

for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  newd2_districts[[i]] <- b_boxgrid_districts[[i]] %>%
  st_centroid() %>% 
  st_as_sf(crs = 4326) %>% 
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2],
         isTreated_child = "Treatment",
         site_code = 0, #dummy
         pt_year_1to59 = 1000) %>% #dummy
  st_drop_geometry() 
  
  newd3_districts[[i]] <- newd2_districts[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(isTreated_child = "Control")
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$newd2 <- newd2_districts
results_spaMM_districts$newd3 <- newd3_districts

```


```{r simulate}
nsim_input <- 1000

# library(doParallel)
# registerDoParallel(cores=2)
# foreach(i=c(newd3,newd2)) %dopar% sqrt(i)

simulated_responses_tx0_districts <- list()
simulated_responses_tx1_districts <- list()
simulated_responses_ate_districts <- list()


for (i in 1:length(districts)) {
  
  print(paste(districts[i],Sys.time()))
  
  simulated_responses_tx0_districts[[i]] <- simulate(results_spaMM_districts$fitmort[[i]],
                                    type = "predVar",
                                    variances = list(linPred=TRUE, disp=TRUE),
                                    nsim = nsim_input,
                                    newdata = results_spaMM_districts$newd3[[i]],
                                    seed = 12345
                                    )
  
  simulated_responses_tx1_districts[[i]] <- simulate(results_spaMM_districts$fitmort[[i]],
                                    type = "predVar",
                                    variances = list(linPred=TRUE, disp=TRUE),
                                    nsim = nsim_input,
                                    newdata = results_spaMM_districts$newd2[[i]],
                                    seed = 12345
                                    )
  
  simulated_responses_ate_districts[[i]] <- 
    simulated_responses_tx1_districts[[i]] - 
    simulated_responses_tx0_districts[[i]]
  
}

results_spaMM_districts$simulated_responses_tx0 <- simulated_responses_tx0_districts
results_spaMM_districts$simulated_responses_tx1 <- simulated_responses_tx1_districts
results_spaMM_districts$simulated_responses_ate <- simulated_responses_ate_districts

save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))

# Confirm units, since they're whole numbers.
for (i in 1:length(districts)) { 
  print(median(simulated_responses_ate_districts[[i]]))
}

```


```{r predicted means SE 95CIs}
# Compute predicted means, standard errors, and 95% CIs.
# predicted <- predict(fitmort_1to59_child) # Predicted values from the model

#--------------------------------------
# mean and 95% CI of the
# parametric bootstrap
#--------------------------------------
sim_means <- rowMeans(simulated_responses_ate) # Mean of simulations
sim_sds <- apply(simulated_responses_ate, 1, sd) # Standard deviation of simulations
sim_lower <- apply(simulated_responses_ate, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
sim_upper <- apply(simulated_responses_ate, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)

# Combine results in a data frame for easier inspection
results <- data.frame(
  lon = newd2$lon,
  lat = newd2$lat,
  Simulated_Mean = sim_means,
  SE = sim_sds,
  CI_Lower = sim_lower,
  CI_Upper = sim_upper
)

# Inspect results
head(results)

#--------------------------------------
# posterior probability that the 
# difference in Mortality (ATE) <0
#--------------------------------------
sims_mort_probeff <- apply(simulated_responses_ate, 1, 
                           FUN = function(x) mean(ifelse(x<0,1,0),na.rm=T))


#--------------------------------------
# convert simulation surfaces to a raster 
# to make it a regular set of tiles 
# (rather than points), 
# then to tibble for ggplot2
#--------------------------------------

# edited this 6/1 -- mask and crop changed to district

sims_mort_probeff_raster <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_tx1_child[,2],
  z = sims_mort_probeff,
  mask1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i]),
  crop1 = niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_02==districts[i])
)

sims_mort_probeff_raster2 <- raster_to_tibble(sims_mort_probeff_raster)

```
